page: Microsoft Azure D64ads_v6 is a general-purpose virtual machine belonging to the Dadv6 family, running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. It features 64 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 32 physical cores of an AMD EPYC 9V74 processor with x86_64 architecture, operating at a clock speed of 3.7 GHz. The system is equipped with 256.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced 4.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. Storage is bundled as a 3780 GB local disk, and the instance is capable of utilizing Premium Storage.

In benchmark evaluations, the D64ads_v6 demonstrates strong multi-core capabilities, achieving a top-tier rating in the Geekbench multi-core test with a score of 22151.0. Its AMD EPYC processor supports advanced instruction sets including AVX-512 vector extensions and cryptographic acceleration via AES and SHA_NI. This hardware configuration delivers strong performance in multi-threaded bzip3 decompression, software compilation with Clang, and database operations, as evidenced by a Passmark database score of 29534.58 and Redis SET operations reaching 88.8 million operations per second. Memory performance is characterized by a strong read-only small block cached bandwidth of 4863.97 GB/sec, though uncached large-block read bandwidth falls into the average category at 153.37 GB/sec.

The inclusion of a large 3780 GB local storage volume combined with strong database and web serving throughput of 51.24 GB/sec makes this instance highly cost-efficient for resource-dense, data-intensive applications that do not require dedicated GPU acceleration. The server is well-suited for workloads such as relational databases, Redis caching layers, software compilation pipelines, static web serving, and medium-scale LLM inference tasks.
